It is the fourth map that was added to the game. ==Description== The Shoreline area makes up a large part of the outskirts of Tarkov and is located next to the Port. The area houses a partially abandoned village, modern private housing, agricultural fields, long stretches of beach, a boating facility, gas station, weather station, and a cellular tower as well as other commercial facilities. Shoreline's main point of interest is the Azure Coast health resort which consists of several blocks, exclusively powered by a nearby hydroelectric power plant. The resort had previously been used as temporary accommodation for members of TerraGroup and the corporation's associated divisions in preparation for the evacuation of the Tarkov Port. ==Notes== {{PAGENAME}} is initially only accessible by [[Transits|transiting]]. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]]. ==Features== * Stationary weapons in the form of [[AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launcher]]s and [[NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine gun]]s. * Be aware of [[Map of Tarkov#Border Snipers|Border Snipers]] and [[Map of Tarkov#Minefields|Minefields]]! ===Port Terminal=== The Terminal is guarded by [[RUAF]] soldiers and machine gunners. They are neutral towards the player but will open fire when they get shot, and if a player gets too close to the Terminal without presenting an access item at the port garrison intercom. Check our [[Shoreline#Maps|maps]] to keep a safe distance. ==Usable Keys==
